data.credibility: Management guides transparently for future periods, with pending targets for FY27 regarding volume growth and capital expenditure currently on track and without historical reversals recorded in the provided ledger.

lines.line: Promised over 10% volume growth for FY27, currently pending.
Promised INR 14,000 crores in FY27 capex, currently pending.

bull: Revenue compounded at 21.1% over five years, reaching ₹208,192 cr TTM with record sales of 2,422,713 vehicles.
Extremely strong balance sheet with debt-to-equity at 0.0 and borrowings falling from ₹541 cr in FY21 to ₹83 cr.
Operating cash flow reached 118% of reported profit over five years, showing excellent conversion of earnings to cash.
bear: Growth is slowing down, with three-year revenue growth dropping to 15.7% compared to 21.1% over five years.
Working-capital days stretched unfavorably from -50 days to -29 days over the past five years.
EBITDA margin of 10.0% TTM remains constrained despite peaking at 11.7% in FY26.
